sources.snippet: INSAIT whiteboard policy — bussing task (joint velocity) The custom Action Chunking Transformer built in the INSAIT whiteboard project, fine-tuned on Sombit/bussing_task_new. This is not LeRobot's stock ACT — it is a different architecture (see below).
